fields.summary: The conductor of run 01M7QDTMXTQE8QZQQ2PH2W22VB planned this change set with no owner present. Research: rhiza run spawn (internal/api/run_spawn.go) starts a child, journals a spawn entry and polls the child's record until it says done or exits, then journals spawn-ended and closes a said-done child's pane. The run's engine already polls a conductor step's children (reconcileSpawns records ends through ChildWatcher; askChildren has the arbiter answer their questions). Three design questions went to the arbiter, which answered with Decision spawn-no-wait-wake: --no-wait is opt-in, the engine sends the wake-up when reconcileSpawns journals a no-wait child's end, and a child's question wakes no one. Planned leaves: the --no-wait flag, the engine's wake-up (with the said-done child's pane closed, as the waiting spawn does), and the conduct guides telling a conductor to spawn with --no-wait and end its turn.
fields.title: Autonomous plan of change set 01M7M2FB (run spawn can return)
